top_choice_rationale: Circuit QED (P001) is a sharply defined 2004 discovery, with theory and two experimental demonstrations of single-photon strong coupling and dispersive readout, reproduced for twenty years. It is distinct from the 2025 macroscopic-tunnelling prize, and the Blais, Wallraff and Schoelkopf allocation fits the three-name limit if the citation stays narrow. P002 (lattice clocks) is a close second with tighter two-name credit, but sits in the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control lineage. P003 (Higgs) is a major discovery, but three names cannot fairly represent ATLAS and CMS and it omits Gianotti. It still ranks above no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented tie to Blais, Wallraff, Schoelkopf, Katori, Ye, Della Negra, Jenni or Virdee. Documented PAMELA, Fermi-LAT, PoGO and XL-Calibur connections concern astroparticle work, not these proposals.
